description: Keep every pin of orieg/discipline moving together: the action, the container image (tag and digest), the pre-commit rev, the GitLab CI include and the Claude Code bootstrap without pinned digests.

packageRules.description: One pull request per discipline release, for every place it is pinned.

customManagers.description: The GitLab CI template included from a discipline release tag.

The Claude Code bootstrap `discipline hook install` writes without pinned digests (`sums=release`: it checks the download against the release's own SHA256SUMS), so only its version moves. One with pinned digests (`sums=pinned`) is left to `discipline hook install --agent claude-code --upgrade --pin-sums <SHA256SUMS>`.
